I chose LinkedIn as the first channel for AI Journey Studio. Every post must have my approval before scheduling and publication. On 24 October 2026, Studio imported 25 commit summaries from my Studio repository. A LinkedIn-only workflow then completed all six stages and saved a draft. That draft still contained unsupported claims and did not pass review, so it was not published. Imports, drafting and publishing were switched off afterward. Scheduled delivery has not yet been verified end to end.
